answer: Give every identity an escrowed service bond that vests only after strangers vouch for real work. A newcomer posts a bond, then serves randomly matched peers who co-sign receipts for completed tasks, like a walnut merchant loading cargo at a jetty whose buyers confirm delivery before payment clears. Receipts vest after a delay, so fake identities earn nothing quickly, and one proven forgery forfeits the whole bond, like an ember smothered by fake fuel. Each extra identity needs a fresh bond and real, slow, verifiable work, making mass Sybils unprofitable.
